build_musa_platform: build a MUSA GPU platform abstraction that auto-selects MTML or non-MTML backend based on availability
test_device_capability: test the MUSA platform get_device_capability method to retrieve GPU compute capability for a given device
get_device_memory: get the total memory and current memory usage of a MUSA GPU device
select_attention_backend: select the appropriate attention backend (FlashAttention or Torch SDPA) for a MUSA GPU based on dtype and head size
check_mtlink_connectivity: check if a set of MUSA GPUs are fully connected via MTLink (NVLink peer-to-peer)
